chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Abdullah ibn Ja'far, from Ayyub ibn Nuh, who said:

Ali ibn Shu'ayb wrote to Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him): 'A woman breastfed some of my children; is it permissible for me to marry some of her children?' He wrote back: 'It is not permissible for you to do so, because her children have become like your children.'

key_terms.بِمَنْزِلَةِ: in the status of / equivalent to

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on marrying the children of a woman who breastfed one's children?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Istibsar* clarifies the scope of *radāʿ* (milk kinship) by establishing that a woman’s existing children acquire the same marital prohibition status as her biological offspring when she breastfeeds another’s child. This ruling underscores the Shia scholarly emphasis on the social and familial bonds created through nursing, extending the prohibition beyond direct parent-child relationships to include siblings raised under the same nursing bond.
